question: How many artists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist;

question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock';

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: What is the total amount of all invoices combined?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;

question: What is the total invoice amount for each billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry;

question: Which billing country has the highest total invoice amount?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Show the media type name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId;

question: What is the average track length in seconds?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track;

question: Which employees report directly to Nancy Edwards? Show first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards';

question: How many invoices were issued in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), COUNT(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1;

question: List the id and name of every playlist that contains no tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack);

question: For each support representative, how many customers do they support? Show first name, last name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;

question: What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many different artists have at least one Jazz track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';

question: What is the total revenue for each genre, computed from invoice lines as unit price times quantity? Show genre name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId;

question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Show first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the titles of albums that have more than 20 tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL;

question: What percentage of tracks are priced at 0.99?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UnitPrice = 0.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Track;
